description: CASSI at UNC Charlotte Route is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by North Carolina Department of Transportation. Shuttle route for the Connected Autonomous Shuttle Supporting Innovation (CASSI) at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte (UNC Charlotte) pilot. The North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) partnered with UNC Charlotte to bring the CASSI program to the campus. Please see NCDOT's CASSI webpage for additional information about the program. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Transport, Movements, Internet of Things. Its keywords are CASSI, beep. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-01-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
